area: Jumeirah Beach Road, 27B Street, Villa 5/1B, Jumeirah 1
name: SEVA Table
questions: Which dishes contain quinoa or oats? (Include oat milk in drinks.)
quinoa_oat_flags: High risk. Plant-based health cafés very often use quinoa bowls, overnight oats, granola and oat milk. Ask about every dish.

safe_dishes.note: The whole menu is gluten-free (billed as the Middle East's first fully GF plant-based café)

summary: A long-running fully gluten-free plant-based café in Jumeirah. Quinoa and oats are a likely problem here.
